raw source, raw verifier output, or raw trace text emitted in model-facing fields

policy_correction.new_rule: Do not hard-block solely because a row comes from a repeated org/source adapter. Admit only if lineage, evidence, anti-leak, and task semantics pass; apply diversity weights and warnings for concentration.
policy_correction.old_problem: Stage12355 single-org/single-repo caps were too blunt and could block clean transformed internal data such as MCP core.
policy_correction.reason: Caps are anti-overfit/eval-hacking guardrails, not user-level volume limits. The dataset may scale from a source when transformed into diverse, same-source, verifier-backed roots.

previous_stage12355_plateau_caps.web_stop_condition: Stop Web mining after two consecutive PASS/PASS_TO_PASS-only batches with no FAIL_TO_PASS, no patch-effect proof, and no new repo family.

MCP_or_other_local_repos: focused local verifier command must execute or have authoritative same-source log
source/test hash refs must be concrete and non-vendor
candidate roles must be task-specific, not generic selected-test-anchor reuse
language/repo/source-family concentration must be visible in the ledger
Open_SWE: extract safe state_before/state_after codes without raw text leakage
join chosen action to command/tool observation
run deterministic anti-leak and split checks
admit only train-support unless Level-3/repair proof is complete

weighted_warnings_not_hard_rejects.MCP_core: eligible for train-support reconsideration if distinct package/root/verifier/source/test hashes pass and all stronger claims remain false.
weighted_warnings_not_hard_rejects.OpenHands_or_other_prior_risk_family: defer only when prior heldout/support leakage or overfit risk is specific and documented; do not block solely by org.
weighted_warnings_not_hard_rejects.Open_SWE: source adapter only; raw traces must become internal episode_graph_candidate records and then safe semantic train-support rows. No direct trace-to-training admission.

same_org_or_source_adapter_repeat.note: Weights affect progress accounting and sampling priority, not row validity.
